title: Mailbox/query silently ignores unrecognized filter conditions
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_query parses filter fields (parentId, name, role, hasAnyRole, isSubscribed) via direct JSON field access. Unknown filter fields are silently ignored — the query proceeds as if the filter were not set, returning wrong results rather than an error. RFC 8620 §5.5: the server MUST reject unsupported filter conditions with an 'unsupportedFilter' error. Fix: enumerate the filter object keys and return unsupportedFilter for any key not in the known set.
